links.outcome: Clinician diagnostic accuracy with versus without AI support, assessing overreliance
links.effect: Overall effect of introducing AI was equivocal versus baseline, with differential effect by AI correctness (OR = 10.0 when correct; reduced accuracy when incorrect).
links.quote: The overall effect of introducing AI was equivocal compared to baseline, however, there was a differential effect whether the recommendation was correct or wrong.

screen.reason: Simulated reader study evaluating clinician diagnostic accuracy with and without AI recommendations (including intentionally correct vs incorrect recommendations to measure automation bias), but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
